name: Martial Guard prevents the next 2 damage to target unit
notes: Martial Guard's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Only the base always-available prevention is covered; the [Class Bonus][Level 2+] Floating Memory clause is a passive/reusable-elsewhere property, not a triggered ability, and is out of scope. The applied turn effect is the shared 'EVASIVE_MANEUVERS_2' tag rather than a Martial-Guard-specific name -- the engine appears to reuse one canonical tag for identical numeric prevention effects across cards (same pattern seen with evasive-maneuvers-prevent-2).

rulesClauses: The next time target unit would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 2 of that damage.
